---
title: "rip_presentation"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data <- tibble(
  category = c(
    "Germline monogenic",
    "Acquired structural\n(trauma, stroke, infection)",
    "Immune-mediated",
    "Metabolic",
    "Unknown / multifactorial"
  ),
  proportion = c(2, 40, 5, 2, 51),
  colour = c("#640D5F", "#249D8F", "#FFB200", "#EB5B00", "#118AB2")
) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category),
    fraction = proportion / sum(proportion),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
    label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    label = paste0(proportion, "%")
  )

ggplot(data, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 4, xmin = 3,
                 fill = category)) +
  geom_rect(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  #geom_text(aes(x = 3.5, y = label_pos, label = label),
   #         size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(c(2, 4)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(data$colour, data$category) #,
    #labels = paste0(data$category, " (", data$proportion, "%)")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Epilepsy aetiology", fill = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm")
  )
```
